simple.meaning: עַנְוָה (ʻanvâh) is a Hebrew word meaning “mildness (royal); also (concretely) oppressed.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: עַנְוָה (H6037) appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Psalms 18:36, with occurrences in Psalms.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to עַנְוָה (H6037) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in עַנְוָה (H6037) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: עַנְוָה (ʻanvâh) / H6037 is traced through Psalms 18:36, Psalms 45:5 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.

definitions.full: H6037. anvah עֲנָוָה noun feminine humility: — Prov 15:33 3 t.; עַנְוָהֿ (contracted because of Maqqeph, see Br Mp ) Psa 45:5 ; עֶנְוָָֽתְךָ 18:36 (= עֲנֹתְךָ 2Sam 22:36 see I. ענה ; read עֶזְרָֽתְךְ Ol We); — 1 humility, meekness Psa 45:5 (dubious), Prov 15:33 ; 18:12 ; 22:4 ; Zeph 2:3 (probably gloss, see We Now). 2 condescension Psa 18:36 (dubious, see above).
